title: Green Beans in Harissa and Preserved Lemon
subtitle: served over white rice
description: Green beans cooked down with fresh chilli, tomato, preserved lemon and a spoonful of homemade harissa, finished with lemon juice and served over rice.

steps.text: Make the harissa: soak both kinds of dried peppers in plenty of water overnight, then drain. Blend the peppers, 1 teaspoon salt and the juice of half a lemon in a food processor to a smooth paste. Transfer to a clean jar, cover with olive oil, seal and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a wide, shallow pot and fry the trimmed green beans, thinly sliced green garlic, sliced chilli and chopped tomato, stirring, for 3 minutes until lightly golden.

Add a tablespoon of the harissa, the preserved lemon and 1 teaspoon salt, stir gently and cook uncovered over medium heat for 10 minutes until the beans are tender and the liquid reduces to a thick sauce.
Squeeze over the juice of half a lemon and serve in the middle of the table with white rice.
